#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "${1:-}" != "relay" ]; then
  echo "usage: ./ji relay up|status|down" >&2
  exit 2
fi
case "${2:-}" in
  up)
    docker compose -p ji-relay -f deploy/relay/compose.yaml up -d --build --wait
    ;;
  status)
    docker compose -p ji-relay -f deploy/relay/compose.yaml ps
    curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:18090/api/v1/health/ready
    printf '\n'
    ;;
  down)
    docker compose -p ji-relay -f deploy/relay/compose.yaml down
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: ./ji relay up|status|down" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
